Alex Chen: Quick handoff — night shift summary and what to watch this morning.
Alex Chen: Incidents open:
- INC-3412 embed-queue backpressure spike. Current state: mitigated. Action taken: increased worker pool + enabled KV-prefetch fallback. Latency back to ~p95 220ms, error rate down to 0.5% from 4%. Runbook: https://internal.incidents/3412
- INC-3427 transient 500s on /v1/generate (us-west). We rolled the latest canary back at 03:40 and routed traffic to stable. Monitoring shows error rate trending to 0. Reopen if >1% for 10m.

Alex Chen: Ongoing items:
- Disk pressure alert on embed-cache-02 — nodes rotated, GC triggered, should be resolved. Watching disk_free metric.
- PR#842 (rate-limiter edge-case) still needs one more review before merge; Jason flagged a test-flake.

Marta Ruiz: Thanks — I'll keep INC-3412 on my watch for the next two hours and escalate if we see >2x enqueue depth.
Marta Ruiz: For embed-cache-02, what's the plan if GC doesn't hold? Can we spin a warm replacement pool? :thinking:

Alex Chen: Plan B is to spin embed-cache-warm-03 and slowly migrate shards. I left the terraform snippet in the runbook.

Jason Patel: I can take PR#842 after standup. Quick heads-up: the flake reproduces locally with the race flag; adding a tiny lock fixes it but want to pair on that.

Priya Singh: FYI — DB maintenance window tomorrow 02:00–03:30 UTC. Read-replica switchover might add ~200ms to reads for affected region. If anyone has scheduled cron-heavy jobs, consider rescheduling.

Jason Patel: Noted. I'll postpone the nightly evals to 04:00 UTC.

sre-bot: Deploy rollback executed by deploy-bot at 03:40 UTC for canary/us-west. Link: https://deploys/internal/rollbacks/548

deploy-bot: Canary health checks failed at step 4 — automatically rolled back. Root cause under investigation.

Marta Ruiz: I'll take primary pager until 10:00 PT, reachable on pager and Slack. I'll notify infra if embed-queue flares up again.

Alex Chen: Thanks — I have an overlap until 09:00 PT and will be reachable for PR help. Next steps: Marta monitors incidents, Jason merges PR after pairing, Priya coordinates DB notice. I'll update the handoff doc with current mitigation commands and links.

Priya Singh: Sounds good. Added the maintenance note to the infra calendar.

Alex Chen: Handoff complete. :handshake:
Marta Ruiz: Thanks, good work everyone. :thumbsup:
